note: Every closed list of values in this system, written down once.
Nothing generates from this file. Each copy stays written in the language that
owns it — a CHECK constraint in SQL, a literal in the Code node n8n executes,
the sentence the model is given — and tests/value-lists.test.js fails when any
copy stops agreeing with what is here.
A list with no `sql` is one the database never stores. A list with no `gate` is
one no code decides on. Both happen, and both are stated rather than implied.
Adding a value means editing this file first, then every copy it names.

category.means: what an email is. First match in the classification order wins.

matched_rule.means: which rung of the classification ladder fired. The only record of why this email went where it went.
why_not_a_const: The fourteen values are literals spread down the classification ladder, one per rung,
and reading better there than gathered into a list far from the branch that uses them.
The verifier reads the assignments themselves, so the ladder is checked where it is
written rather than against a second copy that could drift from it.

gate.why: manual_review is what every category not named in the map falls back to

gate_color.means: how ready a decision is for a human: green is one click, red is not.

segment.means: who is writing. Commercial work is never answered automatically.

geo_zone.means: how far the address is. Out means outside the service area.

message_status.means: where an email has got to.
message_status.not_produced_by_gate: the SQL that hands a message to its lane sets this, not the gate

area_status.means: how the square footage got its number, or why it has none.

material_category.means: the five things the firm installs. Anything else is out of scope.

existing_floor_action.means: what happens to the old floor. Removal can add half the job again.

reachability_untested.floating: accepted and stored, but no branch of the gate depends on it — it is what the assumptions already state when no method is given
reachability_untested.loose_lay: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.peel_and_stick: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it

fixing_method.means: how the new floor is fixed down. mortar_set and thinset are tile work, which the firm refuses.

reachability_untested.straight: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.staggered: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.random: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.offset: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.brick: accepted and stored; the gate takes no branch on it
reachability_untested.chevron: shares the extra-labour branch with herringbone, which a fixture reaches
reachability_untested.basketweave: shares the extra-labour branch with herringbone, which a fixture reaches

pattern.means: how the planks are laid. Herringbone and chevron cost more labour, diagonal wastes more material.
pattern.why_no_sql: the pattern is kept inside the extracted JSON, not in a column of its own

reachability_untested.offer_response: the gate branches on three intents only — complaint, scheduling and follow_up. This one is stored and never read, so no decision can demonstrate it

intent.means: the model's guess at what the sender wants. An input to classification, never the classification itself.
why_constrained_now: The database still never constrains raw model output — it constrains what the gate accepted
of it. messages.intent used to hold the answer lowercased and nothing more, so nonsense in
was nonsense stored and an empty answer became an empty string. The gate now writes a value
from this list or null, which is what earns the CHECK. The raw answer is still kept, in
extracted, where nothing is constrained and nothing is trusted.

direction.not_produced_by_gate: prepare-fields sets this from the transport headers, before the gate runs

sender.means: who wrote it. The owner's own mail must never be answered.
sender.not_produced_by_gate: prepare-fields sets this from the transport headers, before the gate runs

source.means: how it arrived. A platform lead often has no usable reply address.
source.not_produced_by_gate: prepare-fields sets this from the transport headers, before the gate runs

order_state.means: where the work stands. booked, done and lost are closed; everything else is open.
order_state.not_produced_by_gate: the order layer moves it, and the owner moves the last two

order_event_kind.means: why a line was written in an order's history: it was created, a fact merged, a fact corrected, its state moved, or a draft ratified.
order_event_kind.not_produced_by_gate: written by the order layer, not by the decision gate

offer_status.means: where a quote stands. draft: worked out, nobody has seen it. awaiting_approval: put in front of the owner and not answered. sent: the customer has it.

offer_outcome.means: how it ended, once it ended.

price_component.means: which part of a job a rate belongs to. Stairs are priced per step, not per square foot.

offer_refusal.means: why a price was not put in front of a customer. Every one is a state the quote lane refuses to guess its way out of.
offer_refusal.why_no_sql: a refusal is carried on the item to the owner, never stored — the message keeps its own gate_reasons

breakdown_kind.means: what one line of a quote is for. A customer reading a total is owed the parts it is made of.
breakdown_kind.why_no_sql: the breakdown is written into offers.breakdown as jsonb, which no column constraint can whitelist

price_band_event_kind.means: what a price-list sync did to one row. A row never leaves the table, so leaving the spreadsheet is an event like any other.

place_status.means: how far the gate got with the address: whether it was given, recognised and inside the area.
place_status.why_no_sql: computed for the reasons the gate gives and not stored on its own

product_status.means: how far the gate got with the material: in the catalogue, refused, offered but unpriced, or absent.
product_status.why_no_sql: computed for the reasons the gate gives and not stored on its own

area_unit.means: what the customer measured the area in, read from the words they wrote and never assumed.
why_no_fixture_field: This list is what the gate stores, not what the model may write. A customer writes sq ft,
square metres, sq yd; the gate reads whichever of those it sees and keeps the one name.
Holding fixtures to the stored spelling would forbid them from testing the reading, which
is the part that goes wrong. What the gate emits is checked by the reachability arm instead.

comparable_area.means: the area_status values solid enough to compare one job against another. A guess is not a signature.

offer_answer.means: which way a reply to a quote went. NULL when it was neither, which is a real thing: a question about timing is not a refusal.
